dependencies.name: snowflake
dependencies.source: path reference via SNOWFLAKE_SOURCE_DIR (external git checkout, not vendored; consumed via add_subdirectory, required target snow::net)
dependencies.verify: configure-time, inside engine/CMakeLists.txt if(BREAK_ENABLE_SNOWFLAKE): `git -C ${SNOWFLAKE_SOURCE_DIR} rev-parse HEAD` must equal BREAK_SNOWFLAKE_PIN (this entry's version commit), else FATAL_ERROR naming pinned/found/update-procedure; when BREAK_ENABLE_CRYPTO=ON the same block additionally FATAL_ERRORs unless the tree ships src/snow_openssl.c and reports SNOW_HAVE_OPENSSL=TRUE after add_subdirectory (fail-closed; the snow_openssl_stub.c NOSYS build is accepted only with BREAK_ENABLE_CRYPTO=OFF). Moving the pin requires updating BREAK_SNOWFLAKE_PIN, this entry, and docs/design/snowflake_c11_adapter.md in the same commit.
